llm.summary: This skill is not overtly malicious, but it gives agents broad here.now account, private Drive, credential-storage, and sharing-token authority beyond the simple hosting description.

dimensions.detail: The artifact body discloses both website publishing and private Drive storage, but the frontmatter description primarily frames the skill as instant web hosting. The actual capability set also includes private Drive read/write/delete/export/import, profile/account-related management via docs, and Drive share-token creation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill tells agents to fetch current docs on broad here.now-related interactions and to trust live API behavior over local text, expanding operational scope beyond the packaged instructions. It also instructs agents to save returned API keys themselves.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is documented as a global `npx skills add heredotnow/skill --skill here-now -g`; the artifact contains shell helpers but no hidden installer or dependency package payload, and static scan metadata is clean.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network calls, local file reads for publishing/import, and local writes for exports/state are coherent with hosting and Drive storage, but they can expose selected local files and private cloud content to here.now.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill persists API keys in `~/.herenow/credentials` and claim tokens in `.herenow/state.json`. The Drive helper can create write tokens, optional token-management tokens, and full-Drive tokens when no prefix or TTL is used.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review this before installing. Use it only if you are comfortable letting an agent upload chosen files to here.now, store and use a here.now API key from disk, manage private Drive contents, and create Drive sharing tokens. Prefer narrow path prefixes, short TTLs, read-only tokens where possible, and avoid installing globally on shared machines.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Shell execution and outbound network access are expected for a hosting/storage helper, but the minimal manifest under-describes those capabilities relative to the body and scripts.
[TP4] unexpected: The scanner's mismatch concern is supported: the frontmatter emphasizes web hosting while the artifact also enables private Drive and broader account operations.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The artifact does disclose Drives in the body, but not up front in the manifest description, creating a consent-scope mismatch for users approving a hosting skill.
[SDI-2] expected: Share tokens are purpose-aligned for Drive handoff, but write access, optional manage-token privilege, and lack of enforced prefix/TTL are high-impact and under-scoped.
[SQP-1] expected: Fetching docs can be reasonable for a live service, but the activation criteria are broad enough to cause unnecessary external requests or skill use.
[SQP-2] expected: Credential storage is expected for permanent authenticated publishing, but the instructions favor immediate local persistence without a clear user-facing opt-in warning.
